in_hebrew.name: נואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Nowell is derived from the Hebrew name 'נואל' (Nōwēl), which means 'God is with us'. This name has its roots in the Hebrew Bible and is a popular name in the Jewish and Christian traditions.

in_greek.name: Νωελλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Nowell in Greek is translated as 'Νωελλος' (Nōellos), which means 'God with us'. This name is derived from the Hebrew name 'נואל' (Nōwēl) and has been widely used in the Greek-speaking world, particularly in the Eastern Orthodox Church.

in_latin.name: Novalis
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Nowell is 'Novalis'. While not a direct translation of the original Hebrew meaning 'God is with us', this name may have been derived from the English word 'new', which is cognate with the Latin word 'novalis'. This name has been used in various contexts throughout history, including in literature and philosophy.
